ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: a sickness in the wild plants

texts.li: [wilt] {A_nameDef} came in from the woods with a twig of brown leaves. The {KIND} out there are wilting in the middle of the growing season, {COUNT} of them already, and it goes from tree to tree among them. {B_nameDef} wants the sick ones felled now, with the trees standing next to them; {A_nameDef} has seen a wilt burned out before, and says fire is surer.

[wilt,lowtech] The old foresters knew this one as the wilt. {A_nameDef} found it in {COUNT} {KIND}, the bark split and the leaves gone brown, and it creeps from root to root. {B_nameDef} says fell them and the ring round them; {A_nameDef} says burn the sick wood where it stands, before it reaches the rest.

[wilt,!lowtech] {A_nameDef} cut a sample from one of the {KIND} and showed the council the dark streaks in the wood: a wilt, a fungus that travels through the roots. {COUNT} trees have it so far. {B_nameDef} wants them felled along with the ones around them; {A_nameDef} would rather burn the patch out.

[wilt,near] There is wilt in {COUNT} {KIND} close to the colony's own ground, and {A_nameDef} says the trees beside them will have it next. {B_nameDef} wants the sick trees down and their neighbours with them, before the woods round the colony are full of dead wood.

[rust] The grass {A_nameDef} walked through this morning left an orange dust on {A_possessive} boots. It is rust, in {COUNT} patches of grass already, and the wind carries it. {B_nameDef} would cut the sick grass out; {A_nameDef} would burn it off before it spreads, and let new grass come up in the ash.

[rust,lowtech] The herders know it as grass rust: the blades go orange and fall flat, and the beasts won't graze it. {A_nameDef} counted {COUNT} patches of it. {B_nameDef} says cut it out; {A_nameDef} says the old way is fire, on a dry day with the wind away from home.

[rust,!lowtech] {A_nameDef} brought a handful of grass to the council: the blades are covered in orange spores. Grass rust, in {COUNT} patches so far, and it travels on the wind. {B_nameDef} wants the sick grass cut; {A_nameDef} would burn it off.

[rot] The berry bushes have gone soft and grey with rot, {COUNT} of them so far. {A_nameDef} says the fruit will rot on the stem this year and the rot will move to the next bush. {B_nameDef} wants the sick bushes cut out; {A_nameDef} would burn them.

[rot,lowtech] {A_nameDef} came back from gathering with an empty basket: the berries are grey with mould on {COUNT} bushes, and the leaves are going the same way. The old gatherers would cut the sick bushes down or burn them. {B_nameDef} says cut; {A_nameDef} says burn.

li.label: Cut out what is sick, and what grows beside it
li.outcome: The sick {KIND} and those growing beside them are marked for cutting, and the best grower and two others go out to cut them before it spreads further.

lines.li: Cut it below the brown, or it comes back.
Don't touch the healthy ones with that blade.
There's another one over here with the spots.

li.label: Burn it out
li.outcome: On the first dry day {A_nameDef} goes out to the far edge of the sickness with fire and sets it alight. The fire will take the sick {KIND} and some of what grows round them, and the burnt ground will grow back.

li.label: Let it run its course
li.outcome: The council leaves it alone. The sickness goes where it goes, and the land grows back after it in its own time.

li.label: left the sickness alone
li.description: I found the sickness in the wild plants, and the council let it run. I see more of it every time I go out.
